programme.title: Unlocked
programme.desc: CIA interrogator Alice Racine is called into action when she uncovers plans for a deadly biological attack on the citizens of London.

programme.title: The 355
programme.desc: When a top-secret weapon falls into mercenary hands, a wild card CIA agent joins forces with three international operatives on a lethal mission to retrieve it.

programme.title: RED
programme.desc: Retired black-ops CIA agent Frank Moses is living a quiet life alone - until the day a hit squad shows up to kill him. Frank must reunite his old team in a last-ditch effort to survive, and find out who wants him dead.

programme.title: Brothers in Arms (2019)
programme.desc: Cal is a by-the-book police officer and Marine Corps reservist. When his reckless younger brother is arrested, Cal must decide how far he'll go to fight for his family.

programme.title: Dirty
programme.desc: Over the course of one day, a gangbanger-turned-cop is forced to choose between his conscience and his loyalty to the code of blue.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Thrilled by his experience with the Avengers, Peter returns home, where he lives with his Aunt May. Under the watchful eye of his new mentor Tony Stark, he begins to navigate his life as high-school teen and secret super-hero.

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: After the death of his fiancee at the hands of terrorists, Mitch Rapp is drawn into the world of counterterrorism, mentored by a tough-as-nails former Navy S.E.A.L. Stan Hurley.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
programme.desc: Even your friendly neighborhood superhero can use a vacation. But a new threat forces Peter Parker to swing into action during a school trip to Europe.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Hot shot fighter pilot Maverick is out to become the best of the best in the Navy's elite Top Gun school. But as a talented yet reckless flyer he's got a lot to learn.

programme.title: Bad Man
programme.desc: After a drug-related murder shakes his small town, Deputy Sam Evans finds himself working with undercover agent Bobby Gaines, a hotshot narcotics officer who doesn't play by the rules.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: A ruthless former comrade is back and on a mission to end the Expendables. Ross augments the team with new recruits, leading to a clash of old-school methods vs. high-tech expertise.

programme.title: Relentless
programme.desc: A destitute man breaks into the home of an elite cybersecurity expert, igniting a tense game of cat-and-mouse that spirals into blood-spattered chaos - but it'll take an unhinged level of brutality to reveal his true motive.

programme.title: Long Gone Heroes
programme.desc: An ex-special forces soldier is forced back into the field to save his niece, who has been kidnapped in South America. As the fight intensifies, he and his team discover that her disappearance is part of a something much bigger.

programme.title: RED 2
programme.desc: Retired black-ops CIA agent Frank Moses reunites his unlikely team of elite operatives once again - this time for a globe-trotting mission tracking down a missing portable nuclear device.

programme.title: Three Kings
programme.desc: At the end of the Gulf War, a small band of American soldiers seek adventure and fortune by attempting to steal a huge cache of gold hidden somewhere in the desert.

programme.title: Apocalypto
programme.desc: Set against the turbulent end times of ancient Mayan civilisation, a young man is captured for ritual sacrifice and must make a desperate bid to escape his fate and get back to the family he loves. Contains English Subtitles.

programme.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
programme.desc: With his secret exposed, Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange to make the world forget. But when the spell goes wrong and unleashes dangerous foes from other worlds, Peter is forced to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.

programme.title: Border Hunters
programme.desc: Former spy Abraham Woodhill enlists an imprisoned ex-operative for a high-stakes mission that takes him through Mexico's jungles, villages, and cartel strongholds.

programme.title: Act of Valour
programme.desc: An elite team of Navy SEALs embark on a covert mission to recover a kidnapped CIA agent from a lethal terrorist cell. Filmed using a cast of real-life active-duty US Navy SEALs.

programme.title: Plane
programme.desc: A dangerous storm forces Pilot Brodie Torrance to land his plane on a war-torn island. When his passengers are taken hostage, the only person Brodie can rely on is an accused murderer who was being transported by the FBI.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Journalist Eddie Brock develops superhuman strength and power when his body merges with an alien symbiote. Twisted, dark, and fuelled by rage, the creature tries to control the new and dangerous abilities that Eddie finds so intoxicating.

programme.title: Boiling Point
programme.desc: Jimmy Mercer is a cop on the edge. He has seven days before he’s transferred - and seven days to wreak revenge on the scum that killed his partner.

programme.title: Takers
programme.desc: A notorious group of criminals baffle police by pulling off elaborate heists. But on their biggest job yet - with $20 million at stake - their plans are interrupted by a hard-boiled detective hell-bent on solving the case.

programme.title: Lady Scorpions
programme.desc: An ex-FBI agent's fight against a crime syndicate becomes personal when they kidnap her granddaughter. She and her daughter - both martial arts masters - form an unstoppable team as they battle to save their loved one and topple a criminal empire.

programme.title: Hummingbird
programme.desc: Homeless and on the run from a military court martial, a damaged ex-special forces soldier seizes an opportunity to assume another man’s identity - transforming into a vigilante in the process.

programme.title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
programme.desc: The world's top bodyguard Michael Bryce gets a chaotic new client: notorious hitman Darius Kincaid. With enemies on their tail, they must put aside their differences to get Darius to court alive and on time.

programme.title: A Working Man
programme.desc: Levon Cade leaves a career in black ops to live a simple life, but his quiet world is interrupted when his boss's daughter is kidnapped. His search to bring her home uncovers a world of corruption.

programme.title: Renegades
programme.desc: While on an assignment in war-torn Europe, a team of Navy SEALs uncover a hidden treasure and orchestrate a heist to return it to the owners.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: Kyle Reese is sent back to 1984 to protect Sarah Connor. But when the timeline fractures, Reese is thrust into a new and unfamiliar version of the past.

programme.title: The Hitman's Wife's Bodyguard
programme.desc: Bodyguard Michael Bryce continues his friendship with hitman Darius Kincaid as they embark on another life-threatening mission - protecting Darius's even more volatile wife, the infamous international con artist Sonia.

programme.title: Operation Fortune: Ruse de Guerre
programme.desc: Super spy Orson Fortune and his team of operatives must recruit a Hollywood star to help them on a globe-trotting undercover mission to prevent the sale of a deadly new weapons technology.

programme.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
programme.desc: When a deranged killer also becomes host to an alien symbiote, Eddie Brock and Venom must put aside their differences to stop his reign of terror.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood
programme.desc: Vietnam veteran John Rambo is forced to flee into the mountains surrounding a small town by a tyrannical sheriff and his deputies, where he must wage a one-man war against his pursuers using his combat skills to survive.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
programme.desc: With governments and enemies on their trail, Ethan Hunt and the IMF team search for the Entity - a rogue AI that could destroy mankind.

programme.title: Blood Father
programme.desc: An ex-con is thrust back into a life of violence when his estranged daughter bursts back into his life, with a ruthless gang in close pursuit.

programme.title: Prisoners Of The Ghostland
programme.desc: Strapped into a suit that will self-destruct in five days, a notorious bank robber is ordered to find a wealthy warlord's runaway granddaughter.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: John Rambo is offered a prison pardon in exchange for accepting a covert mission to the last place on Earth he'd want to return - the jungles of Vietnam.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Rambo mounts a one-man mission to rescue his friend Colonel Trautman from the invading Soviet forces in Afghanistan.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: After being betrayed and left for dead in Italy, a thief and his crew travel to L.A. with a plan to steal back their fortune and bring down their double-crossing former ally.

programme.title: Navy Seals
programme.desc: A group of Navy Commandos face off with Middle Eastern terrorists when they discover a stash of deadly weapons while on a rescue mission.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: The aging patriarch of a New York crime family transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant son, Michael Corleone, pulling him into the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal.

programme.title: Fame
programme.desc: Four teenagers must prove their mettle as they begin their journey at the New York High School of Performing Arts.

programme.title: Arizona Dream
programme.desc: A young man reluctantly leaves New York to attend the wedding of his uncle in Arizona and ends up in some very strange situations.

programme.title: The Man Who Fell to Earth
programme.desc: An alien travels to Earth in search of water for his drought-stricken planet. However, a woman and greed of other men create complications.

programme.title: The Ladykillers
programme.desc: A hapless gang of criminals have their unlawful plans derailed by a little old lady who runs a boarding house.

programme.title: Stand by Me
programme.desc: After learning that a missing kid has been killed near their rural homes, four Oregon boys decide to go see the body. Along the way, they learn about themselves, the meaning of friendship and the need to stand up for what is right.

programme.title: The Princess Bride
programme.desc: A classic fairy tale, with swordfights, giants, an evil prince, a beautiful princess, a few pirates, and yes, some kissing (as read by a kindly grandfather).

programme.title: Mermaids
programme.desc: A single mother relocates to a small town with her two daughters, where a number of challenges help strengthen their familial bonds.

programme.title: The Natural
programme.desc: A chance meeting with a beguiling woman shatters the dreams of a young baseballer. Sixteen years later, he is given another shot at the big leagues.

programme.title: Alive
programme.desc: Stranded after a plane crash in the snow-swept Andes mountains, members of a Uruguayan rugby team must resort to desperate measures to survive. Based on a harrowing true story.

programme.title: The Silent Partner
programme.desc: A bank teller anticipates a robbery and steals most of the cash himself. When the deception is exposed, a chilling game of cat and mouse ensues.

programme.title: Hope and Glory
programme.desc: A very special family, an extraordinary time, and a child's adventure while a world is at war.

programme.title: Cadillac Man
programme.desc: A salesman must sell 12 cars in two days or lose his job, all while contending with a missing daughter, three women, and a jealous husband.

programme.title: North Star
programme.desc: During Alaska's gold rush, Sean McLennon violently takes over miners' claims. Hudson Saanteek escapes McLennon's thugs and returns for revenge.

programme.title: Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: A timid shop clerk finds his chance for success and romance with the help of a giant man-eating plant.

programme.title: Men At Work
programme.desc: The lives of two rubbish men are turned upside down when they discover the city commissioner's body in a bin on their route.

programme.title: Escape From New York
programme.desc: In a dystopian 1997, Manhattan has been turned into a brutal maximum security prison. When the U.S. President's plane is hijacked and crashes onto the island, it’s up to hard-bitten ex-soldier Snake Plissken to rescue him.

programme.title: The Fog
programme.desc: A malevolent force within a supernatural fog traps a remote seaside community. It's seeking revenge against the descendants of the town's founders.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time in America
programme.desc: The story of two boyhood cohorts and their struggle to achieve power in the gangland hierarchy.

programme.title: The Indian Fighter
programme.desc: Johnny Hawk provides safe passage for wagons heading West, but he lets his guard down when he falls for the daughter of a Native American chief.

programme.title: The Elephant Man
programme.desc: With a facial difference due to a rare disease, John Merrick is abused and ostracised, living his life as the 'Elephant Man' in a circus sideshow. However, Dr Treves sees the person beyond the deformities.

programme.title: Apocalypse Now
programme.desc: A U.S. Army officer serving in Vietnam is tasked with assassinating a renegade Special Forces Colonel who is presumed insane.

programme.title: The Godfather, Part II
programme.desc: The history of two generations of crime unfolds. A young Vito Corleone does what he can to survive in Sicily and Hell's Kitchen. In 1950s New York, his son Michael tightens his grip on the family crime syndicate.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: The Addams family welcome a bouncing baby boy, but Wednesday and Pugsley aren't too happy about the new addition. They must all band together when Uncle Fester is snared by a new love with evil intentions.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part III
programme.desc: Daniel and Mr. Miyagi hope for a peaceful life, but their serenity is shattered when Daniel is blackmailed into competing against the vicious "Bad Boy of Karate".

programme.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
programme.desc: Shakespeare's classic comedy of errors, love, confusion, and double crosses.

programme.title: The Lion In Winter
programme.desc: As King Henry II prepares to announce his successor, he calls his estranged queen and sons together to decide who is most worthy.

programme.title: The Third Man
programme.desc: A novelist travels to shadowy post-war Vienna, only to find himself investigating the sudden death of an old friend.

programme.title: Masters Of The Universe
programme.desc: While in a struggle to save the Sorceress of Castle Greyskull, He-Man clashes with Skeletor to recover the extremely powerful Cosmic Key.

programme.title: Kind Hearts And Coronets
programme.desc: A downtrodden relative of the Duke D'Ascoyne plots to inherit the title by murdering the eight other heirs ahead of him in the line of succession.

programme.title: The Graduate
programme.desc: Trying to decide what to do with his life, college graduate Benjamin finds an unexpected diversion when he is seduced by an older woman, Mrs. Robinson, and then starts to fall in love with her daughter.

programme.title: The Deer Hunter
programme.desc: The lives of three small-town steel mill workers are changed forever after fighting in the Vietnam War, the experience leaving them with terrible physical and psychological wounds.

programme.title: School For Scoundrels (1960)
programme.desc: A chronic loser hopes that a school that teaches one-upmanship will enable him to embarrass a rival and woo the woman he loves.

programme.title: Richard III
programme.desc: Having helped his brother King Edward IV take the throne of England, the jealous, hunchbacked, Richard plots to seize power for himself in Shakespeare's powerful tale of deception, manipulation, and outright murder.

programme.title: Kramer vs. Kramer
programme.desc: A career-obsessed father must learn to care for his son after his wife leaves, and then fight a bitter custody battle in court to keep him, in this classic drama that broke new ground and won five Academy Awards.

programme.title: Miss Congeniality
programme.desc: When the FBI discover that a terrorist is planning an attack at the Miss United States pageant, tough-as-nails agent Gracie Hart must go undercover as a beauty queen to stop the crime.

programme.title: What Women Want
programme.desc: An advertising executive thinks that he's God's gift to women. However, his life is turned upside down when he begins to hear what they really think.

programme.title: Meet the Parents
programme.desc: Madly in love, Greg plans to propose to his beautiful girlfriend. But he first needs the permission of her father - who happens to be ex-CIA.

programme.title: Vampires Suck
programme.desc: In this hilarious vampire film spoof, anxious teen Becca is torn between mysterious vampire Edward Sullen and her childhood friend Jacob, with everything coming to a head on prom night.

programme.title: Grown Ups
programme.desc: After their high school basketball coach passes away, five good friends and former team-mates relive the glories of past... with their wives and children in tow.

programme.title: Grown Ups 2
programme.desc: This time around, the grown ups are the ones learning the lessons on a day notorious for surprises - the last day of school.

programme.title: Muriel's Wedding
programme.desc: Muriel spends her days listening to Abba and dreaming of her glamorous wedding. The only problem is - she's never even had a date.

programme.title: Catch and Release
programme.desc: After the death of her fiance, a woman moves in with her late love's three best friends. As they spend more time together, she learns that life may be messy, but love is messier.

programme.title: How to Make Love Like an Englishman
programme.desc: A perennial playboy bachelor, ageing Cambridge professor Richard Haig has his life flipped upside down when he gets his young lover pregnant.

programme.title: Best Man Dead Man
programme.desc: A bachelor party turns into a night of murder when the best man ends up with a knife in him. Everyone is a suspect, only an eccentric private eye can solve the mystery.

programme.title: Faster
programme.desc: A young woman fights to break into the male-dominated world of Formula 1. With the help of a washed-up racer, she sets out to prove she belongs on the grid.

programme.title: Dinner for Schmucks
programme.desc: A rising executive discovers his boss hosts a monthly dinner where the guest who brings the biggest buffoon gets a career boost. He declines the invitation at first, but then he meets a man who would be the perfect guest.

programme.title: Bernie
programme.desc: In a small Texas town, the friendship between a well-liked mortician and a reviled widow becomes the focus of much debate and scandal when the widow turns up dead. Based on a stranger-than-fiction true story.

programme.title: Meet the Fockers
programme.desc: There's only one last formality before Greg marries Pam - their two families have to meet. The unconventional Fockers and the straitlaced Byrnes are woefully mismatched, adding up to a disastrously funny time of getting to know you.

programme.title: Solo Mio
programme.desc: Left heartbroken in Rome after a wedding disaster, a stranded groom’s ruined honeymoon becomes the adventure he never expected, thanks to one determined local and a few meddling vacation couples.

programme.title: Just My Luck
programme.desc: When a lucky Manhattan socialite kisses the most unlucky man on Earth at a masquerade ball, their respective fortunes take a surprising turn.

programme.title: The Breaker Upperers
programme.desc: Two best friends, cynical about love, set up an agency to break couples up as a way to make cash. But when one develops a conscience their friendship is truly put to the test.

programme.title: The To Do List
programme.desc: It's 1993, and high-school valedictorian Brandy Klark decides she needs to shed her uptight image before college. She puts together a list of all the activities - including sex - she missed in high school.

programme.title: Miss Congeniality 2: Armed and Fabulous
programme.desc: Gracie Hart's newfound celebrity has made her the reluctant face of the FBI. But when Miss United States is kidnapped, Gracie is determined to go back into the field to save her friend.

programme.title: Oh, Hi!
programme.desc: When Iris and Isaac's first romantic weekend away doesn't go as expected, Iris resorts to extraordinary lengths to prove she and Isaac are meant to be together.

programme.title: Space Oddity
programme.desc: Alex's dream of going to Mars is about to come true, but then he meets Daisy. As the two wayward souls connect, Alex finds himself questioning whether it’s easier to confront his past or fly away into the stars.

programme.title: Ricky Stanicky
programme.desc: Three childhood best friends invent the imaginary Ricky Stanicky to get them out of trouble. Twenty years later, they're still using him as a handy alibi.

programme.title: Freddy Got Fingered
programme.desc: Gord Brody, a struggling cartoonist, moves back in with his parents. As he clashes with his overbearing Dad, Gord comes up with a lie that changes everything - he spreads a rumour that his father is sexually abusing his brother, Freddy.

programme.title: Jackpot!
programme.desc: A "Grand Lottery" has just been established in California. The catch: kill the winner before sundown to legally claim their multi-billion-dollar jackpot.

programme.title: Northern Comfort
programme.desc: A diverse group of people take part in a course to overcome their fear of flying. Unfortunately, they all end up stranded in Iceland.

programme.title: People, Places, Things
programme.desc: When his wife leaves him for an off-broadway monologist, graphic-novelist Will balances parenting his daughters on the weekend and the unfamiliar waters of single life in New York.

programme.title: Scoop
programme.desc: An American journalism student in London lands a major scoop and begins an affair with an aristocrat as the incident unfurls.

programme.title: The Legend Of Baron To'a
programme.desc: A young Tongan man returns to his old neighbourhood and inadvertently causes the theft of his deceased father's precious pro wrestling title belt. He must learn the warrior ways of his old Dad, so he can get the belt back from local gangsters.

programme.title: Shiva Baby
programme.desc: While at a Jewish funeral service with her parents, a college student has an awkward encounter with both her sugar daddy and her ex-girlfriend.

programme.title: Gambit
programme.desc: An art curator seeks revenge on his abusive boss by conning him into buying a fake Monet, but his plan requires the help of an eccentric and unpredictable Texas rodeo queen.
